appSubtitle: Prepare and print Nepalese bank cheques with calibrated templates and precise alignment.
bankNote: Print ONLY in green zones. Avoid red areas (MICR, security patterns).
bankTemplateNote: Banks marked "template pending" have no measured cheque layout yet.
pickTemplateHelp: Pick the correct bank before entering cheque details.
payeeHelpText: Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed automatically. Up to 120 characters.
dateFutureError: Cheque date cannot be in the future.
amountHelp: Enter whole numbers or decimals up to 2 places.

amountZeroError: Enter an amount greater than zero

wordsHelp: You may edit the generated wording before printing.
verifyAmount: Verify this matches the amount above. Never leave blank.
printHelp: Prints the cheque at actual size. Ensure printer is set to Actual Size (100%).
printReadinessTitleIncomplete: Complete all fields to enable printing
printModeHelp: Choose Direct Feed for blank cheques or A4 Carrier for test prints on paper.
clearAllAria: Clear all cheque details and calibration
clearConfirm: Clear all cheque details and calibration? This cannot be undone.
bankSelectedFromUrl: Selected from the address bar. Choose another bank
noTemplatePreview: Select a bank template to begin
fieldDisabledBank: Select a bank template to enable this field.
noTemplates: No measured cheque template exists for this bank yet. Templates are added only after a physical sample is measured.
banksPageNoTemplates: No measured cheque template exists for this bank yet. Templates are added only after a physical sample is measured.
beforePrintingDirectFeed: For Direct Feed: feed a blank cheque directly into your printer. Set print dialog to Actual Size (100%) — do NOT fit to page. Ensure margins are set to minimum/none. Use X/Y calibration to align if needed.
beforePrintingA4Carrier: For A4 Carrier: print on plain A4 paper. Set print dialog to Actual Size (100%) with no margins. Cut out the cheque along the border. Use X/Y calibration to align if needed.
mmRange: mm range. Calibration is stored per cheque template and per print mode, moves X and Y independently, and never changes the cheque's physical size.
resetCalibrationHint: Reset X and Y to 0 for the current template and print mode
ariaPrintingCheque: Printing cheque — wait for the print dialog
ariaPrintCompleted: Print completed — select a new bank or clear to start over
generatePdfOverlay: Generate a transparent PDF overlay to print on transparency film over an existing cheque
pdfOverlayHelp: Print this overlay at 100% scale on transparency film, then place it over your physical cheque. Only the variable fields (date, payee, amount, words) are printed — the cheque background and MICR band are not covered.
printInstruction: Remember: Print this overlay at 100% scale (NOT 'Fit to Page') on your bank-issued cheque.
disclaimer: Important: This tool ONLY prints variable fields (name, date, amount) onto bank-issued cheques you already own. Verify alignment before use. Not a cheque generator.
printErrorGeneral: An error occurred while preparing the print output.
printErrorCalibration: Calibration would push the cheque off the page. Adjust the X/Y offset values.
printErrorTemplate: The selected bank template is not available for printing. Please choose another template.
printErrorBankDisabled: This bank is disabled. Please choose another bank.
printErrorWordsMismatch: Amount in words does not match the numeric amount. Regenerate or correct it before printing.
printErrorLayout: The selected template has an invalid layout. Please choose a different bank template.
printErrorModeUnsupported: This print mode is not supported by the selected template.
printErrorProfile: Print layout not available for selected mode.
printDialogHint: Opening print dialog. Please confirm Actual Size (100%) in your printer settings.
geometryWarning: Geometry unverified — test-print on plain paper before printing on real cheque stock.
checklistDisclaimer: This checklist verifies application-level data only. It does not confirm physical printer readiness — always check your printer before printing real cheques.

printInstructionTitle: Before printing on a real cheque:
printInstructionDirectFeed: For Direct Feed: feed a blank cheque directly into your printer. Set print dialog to Actual Size (100%) — do NOT fit to page. Ensure margins are set to minimum/none. Use X/Y calibration to align if needed.
printInstructionA4Carrier: For A4 Carrier: print on plain A4 paper. Set print dialog to Actual Size (100%) with no margins. Cut out the cheque along the border. Use X/Y calibration to align if needed.
micrSafetyNote: The MICR band (bottom 0.5 inch) must never be printed over. Any ink on this zone can corrupt cheque processing.
fontHelp: Uses Inter + Noto Sans Devanagari for Devanagari/English bilingual support.
